name: Articulate EU
description:
Connects Claude to Articulate for EU users. Describe the training you're creating: topic, goals, who it's for, and how in-depth it should be. Then open and review the outline created for you in Articulate, and generate the full content for your interactive training. You can also search and browse your existing courses.

Key use cases:

- Create a course outline
- Create a training package outline

_published_faq.name: How do I add Articulate EU to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Articulate EU to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.eu.articulate.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Articulate EU MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Articulate EU provides these MCP tools: generate_course_outline and list_courses.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Articulate EU?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Articulate EU in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.

_published_faq.name: Does Articulate EU MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Articulate EU requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Articulate EU is developed by Articulate. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
